entry.title: Takht-e Soleyman
entry.note: Fresh named OSM way/203537193 v7 retains UNESCO ref1077 and English Wikipedia identity; the enclosing way and mapped lake way/314769016 agree with retained geometry within1mm. Native +X is true north and +Z true east, heading π/2. Northern fire sanctuary, west iwan and southern lake establish the signed layout. The nomination explicitly distinguishes old southeast Sasanian and new south Ilkhanid entrances; the southwest marks in Huff’s phase plans are other excavated remains, not a reason to mirror the site. Gate stations, all internal ruins and 38 tower stations remain proportional reconstructions. Model Y0 is the local plateau floor. Occupied wall feet extend4.8m below it. Only the mapped lake has a flat local opaque water surface atY+.025m; no land slab or whole-precinct replacement is used. The host supplies geological terrain; no measured Iranian elevation datum, bathymetry or continuous hydrologic integration is asserted. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
